payload.core_mechanism_summary: Bottom-up 2D DP: dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i+1][j], dp[i+1][j-1], dp[i+1][j+1]) for '*', else 0; total spruce count = sum(dp[i][j]).
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D table with row-by-row iteration from bottom to top, computing state from three adjacent cells in the next row. This matches the typical dp_2d_state pattern for grid problems.
